Rugs USA Bot · AI says:

Welcome aboard—happy to help you get started!

Here are a few easy first steps:

Shopping & ordering: You don’t need an account to place an order, but creating one makes it easier to view current and past orders and get news about sales and new products.
Picking the right size (especially for custom rugs):
Finalize your furniture layout first.
Decide where the rug will go and measure with a steel tape.
Start measurements about 12"–18" away from the wall so the room doesn’t look crowded.
Use blue painter’s tape on the floor to outline the rug size and make sure you like the placement.
If you ever need to return something:
Start a return online by selecting the item, choosing a reason, and submitting—your return label will be emailed to you.
After that, print the label, securely re-wrap the rug (no loose items), tape the label on, remove or cover any old labels, and drop it at a FedEx location.
You can look up nearby FedEx drop-off spots by entering your ZIP code on FedEx’s “Find My Location” page.
Sharing feedback later:
You’ll get an email about three weeks after purchase inviting you to review your rug—using that email can earn you a promo code.
Or you can go to the product page, click “read reviews” → “write a review”, and share your thoughts.
Trade & protection plans (if relevant to you):
If you’re a pro (designer, etc.), you can apply to our Trade Program online.
We don’t sell new Mulberry plans anymore, but if you already have one, you’ll activate it via the welcome email from Mulberry and can manage it in their customer portal.
Questions about custom rugs specifically: Our customer service team is available 7 days a week by email, phone, or live chat to help with anything related to Custom by Rugs USA.

So, to start: pick your room, lay out your furniture, tape out a rug size you like, then shop for a rug in that size—everything else (returns, reviews, etc.) is there if you need it later.

Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
Here’s a quick rundown of the main options we offer:
Paying: Use major credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay (US only), or Pay Monthly by PayPal (US only). One payment method per order.
Rug pads: Optional but highly recommended for grip, cushioning, and reducing wear.
Custom by Rugs USA: Pick from our custom collection and have rugs or pads cut to your preferred size (up to 12' wide x 27' long). Ships within the contiguous US & Canada.
Samples: For most custom styles, you can order 12" x 12" swatches for $5 to test color and texture before committing.
Shipping: Most orders ship via FedEx, LaserShip, or OnTrac. Oversized rugs (9' x 12' and larger) ship via Pilot Freight.
Returns: If something doesn’t work out, you can start a return online using our self-service return portal.
